forest_15_001.speaker: narrator
forest_15_001.text: The contractor's offer named eighteen bags for collection after dark, at a premium large enough to make the foreman read it twice. It did not identify which accepted stock would supply them. It allowed any available northern material if the expected bags fell short. Rong struck through that clause immediately. The keeper struck through the collection hour because the relevant charges would still be cooling. The foreman stared at the premium, then at the two crossed-out lines, as though both men had damaged the money itself.

forest_15_002.speaker: rong_sui
forest_15_002.text: An attractive price does not give the contractor my customers' accepted bags, and it does not give us northern timber the land office still holds. He may offer a lawful carriage plan for actually released stock. This page offers speed by removing the facts that make the stock usable. I will reply with the actual conditions. If he rejects them, we have lost an impossible offer, not eighteen bags already sitting in our shed.

forest_15_003.speaker: narrator
forest_15_003.text: The contractor sent a representative before the reply left. The man wore a fine red waist sash under a practical coat and carried a purse that sounded deliberately full. He said the office inquiry concerned an old copy, not his current money. He could pay the foreman directly for a supply turn. Rong said the foreman's existing agreement and the lawful stock dispositions still applied. The representative asked whether every sack in the valley had acquired a magistrate. The keeper asked whether he preferred buying fuel that could burn safely.

forest_15_004.speaker: narrator
forest_15_004.text: The representative laughed and asked to see the cooling charges. The keeper showed the marked outer line and the earliest possible inspection interval from the safe side. The man looked at the sealed chamber and said his town buyers accepted warm charcoal. The keeper said warm did not describe a charge that might still hold dangerous heat inside. Lin watched the purse swing at the man's hand. Its sound made each refusal feel expensive enough to tempt someone who had not heard the whole explanation.

forest_15_005.speaker: long_qian
forest_15_005.text: The local plan has two hundred eighty-eight committed bags and twelve planned bags of contingency within the conservative season estimate. The upper yield is not yet a new stockpile. I will not let my kitchens' share become the contractor's night collection because his purse makes a pleasant noise. If Rong wants to release any of his actual accepted stock under lawful terms, that is his commercial decision. Mine is to keep today's meal and tomorrow's fuel attached to things already verified.

forest_15_006.speaker: narrator
forest_15_006.text: Rong declined to release the identified current stock on those terms. The representative turned to the foreman instead. He offered a future advance against later output after the current seventy-bag promise was satisfied, with a northern substitute remedy if permission arrived. The wording sounded conditional enough to be respectable until Pei's deputy noticed the substitute repayment clause again treated the foreman's household as security. The foreman said his household had nothing worth seizing. Wen asked why it needed to be written there, then.

forest_15_007.speaker: narrator
forest_15_007.text: The representative said it was ordinary protection against an unreliable crew. Wen's uncle stood beside the table, jaw grinding. He had once admired hard bargaining when it appeared to bring flour into the yard. Now he asked whether the advance could be offered against the named business alone, with no worker or household pledge and no unapproved timber remedy. The representative said that would cost more. The uncle said then the cheaper page was not the same offer. Lin almost smiled before remembering how much the premium still mattered to him.

forest_15_008.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_008.text: We have learned enough to ask the question before the meal is bought. My uncle just asked it. Answer him plainly. If the advance buys a claim on my sister's house or my next wages, it needs our own accepted terms, and I am not offering them. If it buys lawful later output from the foreman's business, write the actual source and date. If you cannot do that before midnight, the night is not a reason for us to become easier to buy.

forest_15_009.speaker: narrator
forest_15_009.text: The representative packed the page angrily and said another crew would welcome the work. Rong told him to name that crew and its licensed source in the revised quotation. The man left before lunch. The foreman followed him to the gate, speaking too quietly for Lin to hear. Wen watched from the yard, shoulders tense. His uncle remained beside the rejected page and looked as though he had surprised himself. Pei's deputy retained the offered copy with the ordinary business inquiry, without pretending it proved the contractor guilty of forgery.

forest_15_010.speaker: narrator
forest_15_010.text: After lunch, the foreman announced an optional night handling turn at a higher rate. The keeper had authorized no early cooling release. The turn, the foreman said, would only sort material outside the chambers and prepare tomorrow's lawful loading. The proposed hours followed a full daylight shift for several workers. Shi Lan asked for the actual roster, tasks, lighting, and rest arrangements before the commission supplied any route watch. The foreman accused her of making ordinary work sound like a fire operation.

forest_15_011.speaker: shi_lan
forest_15_011.text: Night work can be ordinary and still require people who can see, rest, and stop. I am asking what you intend them to do, because your visitor came with a deadline the keeper rejected. If this is separate lawful sorting, show the separate plan. The watch will not become evidence that I approved a cooling release. The workers need the actual accepted pay and task limits before choosing. Your anger is allowed. It does not answer the roster.

forest_15_012.speaker: narrator
forest_15_012.text: The keeper offered a safe level sorting turn the following morning under his own schedule. The foreman insisted the night premium would disappear by then. Wen asked whether he had accepted another paper at the gate. The foreman said it was none of a carrier's business. Wen answered that it became his business when his shift was used to fulfill it. The uncle stood very still. This time he did not tell Wen to show loyalty first and ask later.

forest_15_013.speaker: narrator
forest_15_013.text: Wen gave notice that he would finish his accepted licensed turn and then seek the keeper's available direct handling placement under its stated trial terms. The foreman called him ungrateful. Wen said the notice was within his work agreement and the paid hours already done remained due. His voice shook. Lin wanted to speak for him and kept quiet because he was already speaking. The uncle asked the foreman to produce the wage book. The threat had found less family shelter than it used to.

forest_15_014.speaker: narrator
forest_15_014.text: The keeper confirmed a direct placement was available after the agreed notice interval, with ordinary pay, training, and review. It was not a reward from Lin, and it did not promise permanent employment. Wen accepted the trial term after reading it. The foreman would have to rearrange his lawful carrying crew. He could hire under the posted terms or reduce output timing. He could not keep Wen by pretending a meal from weeks earlier had purchased the rest of the winter.

forest_15_015.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_015.text: I have done it. I thought I would feel brave. I feel sick. My uncle asked for the book, and that helped more than your saying something grand would have. Do not be offended; I know you were trying very hard to stay quiet. I could hear the effort from across the room. Walk with me to the shelter after this turn. I would like a place where the foreman cannot see my face while I discover how frightened I am of a job I have chosen.

forest_15_016.speaker: narrator
forest_15_016.text: Lin walked with him after the turn. He sat on the safe shelter bench and held his empty lunch bag until the folds became sharp. She told him she liked him before he had changed employers. He laughed weakly and said that was a useful correction. The new placement was an ordinary opportunity, not proof that the foreman's accusation could no longer hurt. They stayed until the watch's next clear-route signal. Then he stood and went to tell his sister himself.

forest_15_017.speaker: narrator
forest_15_017.text: At the kiln, the night sorting plan remained unapproved for the tired daylight workers. A small rested crew could do a separately specified safe task if the employer accepted the conditions and funded it. The foreman supplied a revised list with two workers who had not taken the daytime shift. The keeper reviewed the task boundary and lighting. The contractor's representative returned to argue that the original deadline still mattered. The keeper said the deadline belonged to a page the yard had not accepted.

forest_15_018.speaker: narrator
forest_15_018.text: The representative asked to buy already accepted sacks instead. The buyers' allocations left no uncommitted current stock the keeper could sell on his own. Future contingency remained forecast output under review. The man grew less polite. He said the valley was hiding fuel to raise prices. Rong offered the actual received and reserved quantities relevant to his proposed purchase, excluding private customer details. The representative refused to read them. Lin saw the argument change from finding a supply to making the refusal feel shameful.

forest_15_019.speaker: narrator
forest_15_019.text: By dusk, the safe sorting turn had its own paid two-worker roster and no permission to open cooling chambers or move allocated saleable stock. The keeper assigned a rested supervisor and kept the storage key. Lin's commission shift ended, and she went to the lodge for supper. Wen arrived later with his sister's relieved answer to the new placement. For a while, their bowls felt ordinary again. Then a watch runner came from the kiln with a report of shouting beside the locked storage door.

forest_15_020.speaker: narrator
forest_15_020.text: Shi Lan went with the qualified watch. Lin followed only after being assigned the village-side message and lighting task. At the yard, the contractor's representative stood beside the foreman and the two sorting workers. A saleable sack had been pulled from the reserved bay. Its tag lay torn on the ground. The representative said the foreman had agreed to the collection. The keeper said the key had been taken from its temporary hook while he checked the outer rack. The supervisor had caught the movement before more sacks left.

forest_15_021.speaker: narrator
forest_15_021.text: The foreman said he had allowed only inspection. The representative held the key and refused to return it until his deposit was acknowledged. No deposit appeared in the keeper's accepted stock record. Shi Lan ordered the current handling stopped while the watch secured the aisle and the relevant pages were brought. Lin held the lamp at the doorway. The key looked very small in the man's hand. Its unauthorized use had made the whole yard larger and more dangerous than any promise spoken at the gate.

forest_15_022.speaker: narrator
forest_15_022.text: The representative produced a folded receipt signed by the foreman. Sixteen copper had been accepted as a preliminary collection deposit against eighteen bags. The page identified no released stock and carried no keeper's countersignature. The foreman admitted taking the money but said he expected to make the terms lawful before anything left. Rong asked why a reserved sack had already been pulled from the bay. The representative answered that a deposit proved ownership. The keeper said it proved a payment made to someone who could not sell that sack.

forest_15_023.speaker: narrator
forest_15_023.text: The watchman asked the representative to put the key on the empty table while the district officer was called. He refused and moved toward the yard door. Lin held the lamp there. Shi Lan told her to step clear, leaving the path visible without allowing a sack to leave unnoticed. The man mistook that space for a chance to escape the conversation. He reached for the torn tag, then drew a short knife when the watchman blocked his hand from the allocated stock.

forest_15_024.speaker: narrator
forest_15_024.text: Lin set the lamp safely on the ledge and moved behind the worktable. The representative swung his knife toward the doorway, not yet at a person. The nearest sorting worker froze beside the aisle. Lin called him back along the clear wall. When the man lunged toward that retreat, she used her sheathed blade in the familiar practiced guard, catching his forearm long enough for the worker to pass. The impact jolted her wrist. It did not make her stronger than the room.

forest_15_025.speaker: narrator
forest_15_025.text: The qualified watchmen closed the gap together after the worker cleared. One controlled the knife arm while the other moved the blade away from people and onto the empty table. The representative struggled, then stopped when Shi Lan told him the district officer was coming and the witnessed threat would be recorded. Lin stepped back, her wrist aching, and left the restraint to the watch. She had achieved one narrow interruption. Trying to turn it into a personal victory would have put her back beside the knife.

forest_15_026.speaker: shi_lan
forest_15_026.text: Check everyone before we resume the argument. Lin, sit by the clear door and show the assistant your wrist when she arrives. Worker, tell the watch if you were touched or struck. The knife and key stay under the district officer's custody procedure. No sack moves tonight because a man has made us tired of discussing it. The sorting turn can end safely with its accepted pay. The cooling chambers remain closed under the keeper. We will hear the foreman's receipt in a room without drawn steel.

forest_15_027.speaker: narrator
forest_15_027.text: The sorting worker had not been cut. Lin's wrist was sore from impact, with normal touch and finger movement under the clinic assistant's initial check, but she would rest it and return for review if pain or weakness increased. She had kept her qi field closed during the confrontation; no hurried pulse had added channel strain to a physical bruise. The assistant wrapped the wrist support lightly and told her not to test a heavy grip tonight merely to prove the hand existed.

forest_15_028.speaker: narrator
forest_15_028.text: The district officer received the key, knife, torn tag, disputed receipt, and offered accounts. The representative was held under the witnessed threat and unauthorized-stock inquiry. His deposit claim would not disappear because he had behaved violently; it would be heard against the foreman's actual agreement and authority. The stock remained with the keeper under its allocated custody. Rong and Long checked their relevant receiving records the next morning. No accepted bag had left the yard under the contractor's page.

forest_15_029.speaker: narrator
forest_15_029.text: The foreman looked smaller in daylight. He had spent ten of the sixteen copper on an overdue business provision bill and held six. He could not return the whole deposit immediately. Rong refused to fold it into the earlier twenty-copper crew-debt balance, which remained unchanged after its fifth installment. The new liability belonged to the new unauthorized offer. The foreman said he had intended to solve it before collection. Pei's deputy asked him to write exactly what he expected to supply and when.

forest_15_030.speaker: narrator
forest_15_030.text: His proposed supply was partly future upper yield and partly a northern batch he believed the contractor could help release. The purported boundary copy had encouraged that belief even after the land office rejected it. The contractor's representative had described the rejection as temporary politics. The foreman wanted the premium badly enough to accept that explanation. Lin heard the account and thought of the blue strokes on prospective trees. Hope had become a familiar tool for making a condition disappear before anyone actually removed it.

forest_15_031.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_031.text: You told me my leaving was disloyal. You took a new deposit against bags you did not control, then asked us to work through the night while you called it ordinary sorting. If I had stayed quiet, my turn would have helped make your answer look possible. I am not glad about your trouble. I am glad I asked. I will finish my accepted notice work. After that I am going to the keeper. You do not get to make my wages the apology for this page.

forest_15_032.speaker: narrator
forest_15_032.text: The foreman started to answer angrily and stopped when the uncle opened the wage book. Completed wages were due under the existing terms. The uncle asked for his own next turn to be clarified too. He would continue lawful crew work, but not the rejected night collection. The foreman agreed with a face that suggested agreement had become another loss. Wen did not celebrate. He went to the yard, where ordinary wet billets still needed tags and the new employer's placement would begin only after his notice.

forest_15_033.speaker: narrator
forest_15_033.text: Rong sent the deposit account to his town office with the contractor's actual signed pages. His brother replied requesting the original documents for the forgery inquiry and supporting the refusal to mix debts. He also asked whether the valley stock had been protected without further loss. Rong answered yes. The younger man did not write a paragraph about commercial nerve. Lin suspected the damaged road, the keeper's sacks, and the paper boat had not softened him so much as given his questions better targets.

forest_15_034.speaker: narrator
forest_15_034.text: Long asked the keeper whether the temporary key hook should be removed. The keeper agreed. The new storage arrangement kept the key on the authorized keeper or relief operator, with handover recorded when responsibility changed. The hook had been convenient during rack checks and too accessible to a visitor allowed near the bench. The keeper did not blame the stolen key for lacking judgment. He changed the place humans had given it. Lin watched the simple repair after a night that had nearly made simplicity expensive.

forest_15_035.speaker: narrator
forest_15_035.text: At the clinic, Lin's next check found the wrist bruise improving without numbness or loss of ordinary grip. The assistant advised lighter carrying and no forced reinforcement practice until the movement was comfortable and rechecked. Her earned fourth-stage structure remained, but she would not turn that into a claim that the bruised body could ignore advice. Wen carried the heavier bowl tray that evening. She accepted without making him explain that he was helping the wrist rather than doubting the woman.

forest_15_036.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_036.text: I watched you leave the watchmen their work. I was not there when the knife came out; I heard the account later from the people who saw it. That matters. I would like to turn the story into something where you were invulnerable because I like you. You were hurt, and you were sensible afterward. I prefer the actual story, even if it makes me worry. Give me the tray. You can carry the napkins and insult my knots.

forest_15_037.speaker: narrator
forest_15_037.text: Lin carried the napkins. Their meal on the safe bench had been delayed by the previous night's event, so they chose the next agreed evening instead of pretending the promise had happened unseen. Wen brought two bowls and forgot the spoons. Lin had brought spoons and forgotten the tea. They ate, laughing at the imperfect division of responsibility. The watch bell sounded a clear turn beyond the houses. Neither went to the forest simply because the sound belonged to work they understood.

forest_15_038.speaker: narrator
forest_15_038.text: The shelter timbers arrived during that meal's week. The authorized receiver and carpenter inspected all four pieces at the specified grade before accepting them. One fitting packet was short a pin; the supplier provided the contract remedy from its accompanying spare stock, checked before installation. The eighteen-copper deposit remained part of the fifty-four total, with thirty-six held until the agreed receiving and completion milestones. Lin watched from her lighter task, resisting the desire to lift a beam just because it looked useful.

forest_15_039.speaker: narrator
forest_15_039.text: The qualified crew changed the shelter load under its staged procedure, removing the rotten member only after temporary support and the empty work area were checked. The closed bay stayed closed during installation. Wen carried ordinary small fittings under the carpenter's assignment. His direct keeper placement had now begun, and the paid shift release for this task was accepted between the employers. His uncle watched from the safe side and managed not to direct the saw for nearly an entire hour.

forest_15_040.speaker: narrator
forest_15_040.text: The carpenter completed the durable repair and checked the roof, joints, and weather seal before reopening the bay at its stated occupancy and snow-maintenance limits. The council paid the remaining thirty-six copper under the accepted completion record. The full expenditure was sixty-six: twelve for the earlier separate temporary work, fifty-four for the durable repair. Local maintenance had supplied forty-two and the district supplement twenty-four. The room was sounder than before. It still required snow checks, because repair did not abolish winter.

forest_15_041.speaker: narrator
forest_15_041.text: The elder returned her chair to the improved shelter and sat down as though taking a throne nobody had requested her to hold. She tested the signal sightline and found it good. The boy's grandmother inspected the warmer room and the repaired path together, still keeping the boy's own walks within the clinic plan. Long checked the handcart return interval. Rong checked the route's actual commercial turn. Lin stood near the door and noticed people using the room without asking her to admire how much effort it had cost.

forest_15_042.speaker: narrator
forest_15_042.text: That evening, the contractor sent a sharp demand for the sixteen-copper deposit's return and alleged that the valley had unlawfully obstructed his trade. The district officer answered through the actual case procedure, separating the repayment claim from the threat and unauthorized stock movement. The foreman retained his copy. The forgery hearing would examine the contractor's document chain in the sixteenth week. Lin read only the offered public update and went home. A louder letter did not require every person in the village to lose another night's sleep.

forest_15_043.speaker: narrator
forest_15_043.text: The foreman returned the six copper he still held through the district case desk. His new deposit liability therefore stood at ten pending the repayment decision, separate from the twenty remaining on the earlier revised advance. The contractor's demand for sixteen was corrected to acknowledge the actual returned money. No one treated that partial return as settlement of the threat or authority question. Wen saw the receipt at the ordinary wage handover and felt a sour relief that at least one balance had stopped growing through argument.

forest_15_044.speaker: narrator
forest_15_044.text: The direct keeper placement began with training Wen on tasks he thought he already knew. The keeper asked him to read a batch tag and describe its date. Wen missed the second mark and received the same patient look Lin had earned months earlier. She was present at the lighter sorting bench and delighted enough to be unkind for one breath. Wen asked whether she could restrain the delight until lunch. The keeper said both could restrain themselves until the sacks were counted.

forest_15_045.speaker: narrator
forest_15_045.text: Wen's uncle visited the yard at the end of the first shift. He did not ask his nephew to come back. He asked whether the new terms included ordinary rest and what happened if the trial placement ended. Wen showed him the page. The uncle read slowly, accepting help with one cramped line. The employer change had made him nervous because he understood his own crew's faults better than another man's promises. Wen thanked him for asking the practical questions instead of calling the new job betrayal.

forest_15_046.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_046.text: I used to believe he would never understand why I left. Now he is worried about whether the keeper can keep me. That is a different worry, and I can bear it better. I am still angry about some old things. He is still irritated when I quote the page. We have not become a new family because one contract changed. We have found another way to remain in the old one without letting the foreman stand between every conversation.

forest_15_047.speaker: narrator
forest_15_047.text: Lin told him that sounded like good news. He said it was good news and he wanted to complain about the keeper's date questions anyway. She invited the complaint. They ate beside the safe bench with both spoons present this time. The niece discovered them and asked whether private suppers contained better pickles. Wen offered her one after checking with the caregiver. She decided the inspection had succeeded and left. Lin admired the economy of an examiner who could be satisfied by a pickle.

forest_15_048.speaker: narrator
forest_15_048.text: The wrist review later that week found normal ordinary grip and movement without the earlier ache. Lin resumed light practice only after that check, using the local workroom's loaned calibrated wick and grounded return lead. The kit stayed at its station under the commission's accepted equipment arrangement. She ran one familiar quarter-unit task through the first established arm pair, spending the permitted half-unit from her measured reserve, then fully discharged. The physical wrist remained comfortable. A second pair's test would wait for the next recovered session.

forest_15_049.speaker: narrator
forest_15_049.text: She wrote the sampling cost and actual task expenditure separately. The quiet result pleased her more than a story of gaining power from danger. The representative's knife had taught her where a worktable stood, how fast fear could narrow an aisle, and why watchmen trained to restrain people belonged near the threat. It had not opened another meridian. Wen watched the empty wick cool and said he was glad the room had returned to being boring. Lin said boring required surprisingly good practice.

forest_15_050.speaker: narrator
forest_15_050.text: At the next recovered session, the second established arm pair completed its own permitted task with controlled interruption and full discharge. The local blank and reference check were recorded before the trial, and the result stayed within her existing fourth-stage qualifications. Her next-day touch and grip remained normal. Lin had not recovered by daring the wrist to obey. She had recovered by letting an ordinary bruise finish being ordinary. The lesson felt less heroic and more likely to remain useful.

forest_15_051.speaker: narrator
forest_15_051.text: The contractor's representative sent an account blaming the foreman for a mistaken stock sale and claiming the knife had been drawn only to prevent unlawful detention. The sorting workers' independent accounts described the movement toward a retreating worker and the watch's request to set down the key before any restraint. Lin offered her own narrow view from the doorway. The district officer compared the sequences rather than ask one frightened person to describe the entire room. The actual deposit claim could survive even if the self-defense claim did not.

forest_15_052.speaker: narrator
forest_15_052.text: Pei assisted the deputy with the old commercial papers requested for the forgery hearing. The contractor's copy, agent's covering note, original road order, receiving dates, and printed supplier circulars were arranged in sequence. One circular quoted the added boundary phrase before the contractor claimed he had first received it. The discrepancy required explanation. Rong sent the relevant town dispatch page. Long sent the local manager's original received message. The paper chain was becoming harder for a convenient traveling clerk to carry alone.

forest_15_053.speaker: narrator
forest_15_053.text: The contractor answered that the earlier circular had been drafted later with an old date. His printer was asked for the actual work order and payment record. He could give the order date from his book and the person who supplied the wording. The district office would take his account directly. Lin liked the new lead because it came from a business making ordinary dated things, not a spirit seeing through deception. The Frostroot Harts had enough trouble carrying their own frightened bodies.

forest_15_054.speaker: narrator
forest_15_054.text: At the refuge, the five animals used the current combined arrangement with fewer close approaches. The young newcomer had learned the wider interior turn; the known youngster's injured leg remained under distant qualified observation. The adult Hart thanked the watch for keeping dogs out of the approach. It declined an invitation to view the new shelter. Shi Lan accepted the refusal, amused at having accidentally offered hospitality to a creature whose head could rearrange her repaired roof.

forest_15_055.speaker: frostroot_hart
forest_15_055.text: Your room is for bodies that fit its door. Mine does not. I can hear the people warmer beyond the wall, and that is enough visiting today. The small one sleeps longer now that the reeds no longer catch the braid. I will not send it closer so your boy can see a recovering creature. Let them both grow stronger before you arrange a meeting between two hopes with injured feet.

forest_15_056.speaker: narrator
forest_15_056.text: Lin relayed the offered words to the boy's family at the next shared report. The grandmother laughed at the image of two hopes and said neither should be allowed to organize the meeting. The boy objected from his warm chair. His foot had improved enough for carefully staged walking, but the assistant kept the next review. He was learning to complain at normal volume, which everyone privately preferred to his earlier weak answer. Lin left the paper dog on its permitted shelf.

forest_15_057.speaker: narrator
forest_15_057.text: The durable shelter passed its first snow check after reopening. The repaired beam and joints held within the approved load and maintenance plan. The watch cleared excess snow under the safe procedure, keeping people outside the work area. The elder watched from the council room and accused the chair there of being inferior. Wen said the chair could appeal through the deputy. She told him not to mock the only institution that reliably supported her knees. He apologized to both chairs.

forest_15_058.speaker: narrator
forest_15_058.text: A household wood carrier missed the revised turn because his child became ill that morning. The watch arranged the next available accepted slot rather than treat the absence as withdrawal from the access plan. The illness belonged to the family and its clinic, not to the movement record. Lin helped carry the rescheduled bundle under her now comfortable light task. She noticed how the winter system had begun allowing ordinary interruptions without immediately turning them into a crisis requiring a new heroic volunteer.

forest_15_059.speaker: narrator
forest_15_059.text: The foreman's sixth installment became due after the next accepted lawful income. He paid four copper on the earlier advance, reducing twenty to sixteen. The new deposit balance remained ten after the six returned. His crew's hiring had adjusted around Wen's departure, with one new worker trained under the posted terms. Output timing had slipped but not vanished. The foreman looked exhausted. Lin hoped the exhaustion might teach him something and recognized the unfairness of wanting another person's fatigue to become her proof.

forest_15_060.speaker: narrator
forest_15_060.text: Rong went to the foreman after the receipt was written. He asked for the actual next delivery estimate and offered no additional advance against the northern stand. The foreman gave a smaller figure he believed he could meet. Rong accepted the revised staging discussion under the existing terms. The conversation was chilly and useful. Neither had to like the other enough to forget the night deposit. Lin saw their signatures made slowly, with the bags and dates finally matching the people who would have to carry them.

forest_15_061.speaker: narrator
forest_15_061.text: Long's kitchen maintenance check found one new latch loosening before it failed completely. The paid worker repaired it during the stated appointment. The thirty-bag saving remained supported by the verified operation and existing dry mixed-fuel stock, not merely by the old trial. The cook sent the result to the office and kept serving. Lin helped wash after the evening turn. Wen's sister asked about her wrist, then asked about Wen with a smile that made the first question look like a diplomatic opening.

forest_15_062.speaker: narrator
forest_15_062.text: Lin answered both plainly enough to make the sister laugh. She liked Wen. She was not promising the forest her whole future. The sister said she had asked whether he remembered the spoons, not whether they had negotiated eternity. Lin blushed and complained that the family had become too clever since the roof was finished. The sister said a dry house freed considerable mental effort. They washed the last bowl, and Lin left smiling at a future she still did not know how to describe.

forest_15_063.speaker: narrator
forest_15_063.text: At the twelfth week's end, the preliminary weather observers reported a genuinely different pattern: steadier upper wind, better drying on the approved surface patch, and clear air through the hollow during the observed intervals. The operational reviewer requested the full next-day checks before any callout. Shi Lan read the report twice. The line was prepared, the exclusions updated, the crew arrangements current. Winter had finally offered a possible opening. This time the possibility rested on the ground they could examine, not on a premium written beside midnight.

forest_15_064.speaker: narrator
forest_15_064.text: The following morning's ground inspection found the approved surface patch ready under the plan's moisture conditions, with the deep-soil seams still excluded. The upper wind remained within the stated operating range through the observed interval, and smoke did not settle in the occupied hollow. The reviewer kept the decision conditional on the actual ignition-day checks. The senior worker opened the readiness box, inventoried it, and closed it again. Lin had learned to distinguish that small ritual from a fire already promised.

forest_15_065.speaker: narrator
forest_15_065.text: The fireline needed fresh attention after weeks of waiting. New needles lay across two cleared lengths, and snowmelt had shifted one edge marker. The paid preparation crew restored the approved line under the senior worker's check. The widow's protected resting tree remained outside the patch. The qualified saw crew verified no new hanging branch threatened the assembly point. Wen helped carry ordinary tools after his keeper shift release was accepted. The future operation would not rely on a map that had stopped meeting the ground weeks ago.

forest_15_066.speaker: narrator
forest_15_066.text: At the movement review, the habitat observer confirmed the three newcomers had used the deeper refuge turn repeatedly and the known pair remained near the shallow bank. The planned burn excluded both areas, with the current smoke and route triggers preserved. The Hart heard the actual plan during a calm offered consultation. It declined to promise where every animal would stand on the day. Shi Lan had not asked for that promise; the watch would keep reporting actual positions before and during the operation.

forest_15_067.speaker: frostroot_hart
forest_15_067.text: The marked fire is far from the small one's water. I have heard what you intend. I will tell the other bodies where I know the quiet turns, but they are not tools I can place on your drawing. Watch the smoke over the low bank. If it comes, we will move where the air allows. I remember a fire that finished on paper before it finished under the roots. Let this one have people who stay to know the difference.

forest_15_068.speaker: narrator
forest_15_068.text: Shi Lan showed the post-fire watch and cold-ground recheck plan. The qualified crew would remain through the accepted stages, with relief and later inspections funded. The Hart listened, then turned toward its sleeping youngster. Lin carried the offered concern back to the fire reviewer. It added urgency to an existing inspection duty, not authority for the animal to manage the crew. The forest's memory had become one participant in a plan that still needed people trained to act.

forest_15_069.speaker: narrator
forest_15_069.text: Before the current commission interval expired, the council's scheduled review funded the next fortnight of accepted wages, lodging, access work, and observations. The separate fire callout and qualified post-fire coverage were authorized against the actual readiness plan, subject to the remaining conditions. Costs from the rejected contractor offer stayed outside that budget. Pei's deputy read the roster to catch double-assigned people. One messenger had been listed at both the bank and the upper station. The error was corrected before either duty began.

forest_15_070.speaker: narrator
forest_15_070.text: Long reviewed the temporary kitchen delivery staging around the possible operation. The current accepted fuel and verified dry wood stock covered the named service days if handling crews shifted briefly to fire support. Later deliveries retained their actual schedule and contingency. Rong notified his customers of the bounded work interval without calling ignition certain. Both men sounded less impressive than they had in autumn. Their notices were more useful. The cook read Long's and found only one arrival hour to complain about.

forest_15_071.speaker: narrator
forest_15_071.text: The foreman asked to put two rested workers on the paid support roster. Their tasks and accepted rates were clear, and the qualified leader approved them after checking the training required. His crew was not excluded because he had made a bad deposit agreement. His authority over cooling stock remained limited. Wen watched the men receive their assignments without resentment. Leaving one employer did not require him to wish every worker who stayed there a harder winter.

forest_15_072.speaker: narrator
forest_15_072.text: Lin's wrist remained comfortable through the next ordinary work and low-load practice check. She accepted only a support role within her training: either the message station maintaining the route warnings, or the water-supply line moving the prepared equipment under its supervisor. Qualified crew leaders retained ignition and suppression duties. Her field remained fourth stage. The possible work interested her precisely because it would ask for good timing without letting her hide inside a larger claim about power.

forest_15_073.speaker: wen_cai
forest_15_073.text: I am on the keeper's ordinary stock turn during the operation unless the supervisor changes the accepted release. That means I may hear the signals without seeing you answer them. I would like you near the safe station. I know that wish does not choose your task. Tell me which role you accept, and I will understand where to look for the actual report afterward. If I ask whether everything was fine, you may answer with more than the part intended to stop me worrying.

forest_15_074.speaker: narrator
forest_15_074.text: Lin said she would. They ate the promised ordinary meal on the bench, with tea and spoons successfully present together. The niece inspected from a distance and announced that their provisioning had improved. Shi Lan called her back before the inspection became a third seat. Lin laughed. The next day might hold a real surface fire, but this evening held two people learning how to share a bowl without using the future as either a threat or a guarantee.

forest_15_075.speaker: narrator
forest_15_075.text: Before dawn, the qualified observers returned with the last readings. The approved patch remained within its ground conditions, the upper wind was steady in range, the hollow air was clear, and the five Harts were accounted for outside the operation area. The leaders checked the funded crew, water, tools, routes, and relief plan once more. Shi Lan looked at each responsible person before authorizing the limited ignition. The thirteenth week's fire would begin because the conditions permitted it, not because winter had finally become ashamed of delaying them.
